# Copilot Instructions for LactaLink

`AGENTS.md` at the repository root is the canonical instruction file for AI coding agents (architecture boundaries, commands, generated files, engineering rules, docs to keep living). Read it and follow it:

👉 [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)

It links onward to the living documentation set as needed:

- [docs/PRD.md](../docs/PRD.md) — product requirements and scope
- [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) — repo-level architecture and boundaries
- [docs/tech-stack.md](../docs/tech-stack.md) — stack conventions and decision records
- [docs/plan.md](../docs/plan.md) / [docs/progress.md](../docs/progress.md) — roadmap and current status
- [docs/features/INDEX.md](../docs/features/INDEX.md) / [docs/technical-architecture/INDEX.md](../docs/technical-architecture/INDEX.md) — feature and system-level detail
